AZUSA CITY PLANNING COMMISSION
AGENDA
June 26, 2013
07:00 P.M.
NOTICE: A copy of the following public hearing staff reports and Initial Studies, if applicable, for the Planning Commission projects will be available for review during regular working hours of 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday - Thursday at the Planning Division and during regular hours of the Azusa City Library. Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California.

1.
Use Permit UP 2013-05 (Alcohol Sales) Location: 353 E. Foothill Boulevard
APN: 8626-001-031
Applicant: Eugenia Kiouftis, Lambos Restaurants, Inc.
A request for approval of a Use Permit to allow the sale of beer and wine (Type 41 ABC License) at a full service restaurant, previously the California Burger, located at 353 E. Foothill Boulevard. This project is exempt under the California Environmental Quality Act, Section 15061(b)(2)(3) - No possibility that the activity may have a significant effect on the environment.
Item F1 Staff Report and attachments A - C
Item F-1 Exhibit D
2.
Design Review DR 2013-13 & Variance V 2013-01 Location: 314 N . Pasadena Avenue
APN: 8612-010-003
Applicant: Inosencio Lopez
A request for approval of a Design Review and Variance to allow the reconstruction of approximately 400 square feet and the addition of 310 habitable square feet space to an existing residence, with a Variance for a reduced front yard setback of 18' instead of the required 25' and a reduced side yard setbacks to allow the construction of a two-car garage, and a reduced separation between the house and garage of 5'. This project is Categorically Exempt under the California Environmental Quality Act, Section 15303(b) - New Construction or Conversion of Small Structures.
